name: Mathematics
notice: Study material. MathGradify covers maths from everyday numeracy to research-level topics. Exam boards (AQA, Edexcel, OCR, WJEC Eduqas, CCEA, SQA, IB) differ in detail: check your own specification for exactly what you need to know.

paths.name: Everyday maths and Functional Skills
paths.sub: Money, measures, time, data and risk, with the number skills behind them: for adult learners, Functional Skills and anyone rebuilding confidence.

paths.name: GCSE Mathematics
paths.sub: Number, algebra, ratio, geometry and measures, probability and statistics, with exam technique: Foundation and Higher tier.

paths.name: A level Mathematics
paths.sub: Proof, algebra and functions, coordinate geometry, sequences, trigonometry, exponentials and logarithms, calculus, vectors, numerical methods, statistics and mechanics.

paths.name: A level Further Mathematics
paths.sub: Complex numbers, matrices, proof by induction, further calculus and vectors, polar coordinates, hyperbolic functions, differential equations and further statistics.

paths.name: University mathematics: first year
paths.sub: The bridge to degree-level maths: proof and logic, sets, calculus and analysis, linear algebra, differential equations, probability and an introduction to groups.

paths.name: Pure mathematics: degree and beyond
paths.sub: Abstract algebra, analysis, topology, number theory, geometry, logic and foundations.

paths.name: Applied mathematics and engineering
paths.sub: Calculus, vector calculus, differential equations, linear algebra, numerical methods, modelling and control.

paths.name: Mathematics for data science and AI
paths.sub: Linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimisation, time series, information theory and the mathematics of machine learning, with the software to apply it.

paths.name: Financial and actuarial mathematics
paths.sub: Interest and valuation, probability and statistics, stochastic models, risk, time series and optimisation.

paths.name: Discrete mathematics and computer science
paths.sub: Logic, sets and proof, combinatorics, graphs and networks, number theory and cryptography, information and coding.

paths.name: University entrance tests (MAT, TMUA, STEP)
paths.sub: Problem solving and proof on top of A level content, for Oxford, Cambridge and other competitive courses.

exams.title: GCSE Mathematics practice paper
exams.sub: Number, algebra, ratio, geometry, probability and statistics at GCSE level.

exams.title: A level Mathematics practice paper
exams.sub: Pure mathematics, statistics and mechanics-style modelling at A level.

exams.title: Further Mathematics practice paper
exams.sub: Complex numbers, matrices, further calculus and differential equations.

exams.title: University entrance test practice
exams.sub: Reasoning, proof and problem solving in the style of MAT, TMUA and STEP preparation.

exams.title: First-year university mathematics
exams.sub: Proof, calculus, analysis, linear algebra, differential equations and probability.

exams.title: Whole course
exams.sub: Forty mixed questions from every school, from everyday maths to research-level topics.
